Override the Workgroup Holiday Scheme at employee level within the Back Office The Workgroup Override allows the user to override certain workgroup settings at an employee level. Currently the only override setting being utilised is the Holiday Scheme. Update Holiday Schemes in WFM v1.1 Closure dates listed against a Holiday scheme will automatically be recorded as absences against all employee appointments linked to the scheme. Holiday schemes are linked to employee appointments via the Balance assignment. Multiple Balances may be linked to the same holiday scheme. WFM
